documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
documents.notes: Core consumer protection statute.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
documents.notes: Rules for consumer dispute redressal commissions.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Commission Procedure) Regulations, 2020
documents.notes: Procedure regulations for consumer commissions.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
documents.notes: Consumer rules for e-commerce platforms and online sales.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2021
documents.notes: Amendment to the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
documents.notes: Pecuniary jurisdiction rules for consumer commissions.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (Mediation) Rules, 2020
documents.notes: Rules governing consumer mediation.

documents.document_title: The Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021
documents.notes: Consumer rules for direct selling entities and models.

documents.document_title: Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022
documents.notes: Official consumer authority guidelines on misleading advertisements.

documents.document_title: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023
documents.notes: Official consumer authority guidelines for dark patterns in digital interfaces.

documents.document_title: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009
documents.notes: Weights and measures, MRP as a ceiling, mandatory net-quantity and package declarations, verification of weighing/measuring instruments, and related offences and penalties. Substantive basis for overcharging-above-MRP and short-weight complaints.

documents.document_title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
documents.notes: Pre-packaged goods: mandatory label declarations (manufacturer/packer, net quantity, MRP inclusive of all taxes, month/year, consumer-care, country of origin), dual-MRP prohibition, maximum permissible error, and penalties.

documents.document_title: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930
documents.notes: Supporting contract-law background for defective-goods reasoning: implied conditions and warranties, merchantable quality, sale by description/sample, passing of property and risk, delivery, and buyer/seller remedies. Not a consumer-forum statute; use alongside the Consumer Protection Act.

documents.document_title: The Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
documents.notes: Standard Mark / ISI certification, compulsory conformity assessment for notified goods, hallmarking, product recall powers, and penalties for non-conforming or falsely marked goods.

documents.document_title: The Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017 (updated to 18 May 2021)
documents.notes: Remedy route for insurance claim repudiation, delay, mis-selling and policy-servicing disputes: Ombudsman jurisdiction, monetary limit, complaint procedure, award and time limits. Consolidated text incorporating the 2018/2021 amendments.

documents.document_title: The Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (with 2022 amendments)
documents.notes: Cost-free remedy for deficiency in banking, NBFC and digital-payment services (subsumes the earlier Banking / NBFC / Digital Transactions ombudsman schemes). Grounds unauthorised-transaction and payment-service complaints; document_type set to guidelines because ingest.py has no scheme parser.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology Act, 2000
documents.notes: Core cyber law statute.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021
documents.notes: Rules for intermediaries and digital media under the IT Act.

documents.document_title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
documents.notes: Rules made under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023; the Act itself is not present as a standalone PDF.

documents.document_title: User Manual for Reporting Cyber Crime Against Women and Children / Citizen Manual for National Cybercrime Reporting Portal
documents.short_title: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal User Manual, 2019
documents.notes: Procedural guide, not a statute or rule.

documents.document_title: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
documents.notes: Broad criminal law retained as supporting material for cyber-adjacent offences (identity, cheating by personation, obscenity, voyeurism, stalking, extortion, criminal intimidation). Candidate for replacement by a curated cyber-sections extract to cut retrieval noise.

documents.document_title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
documents.notes: Primary data-protection statute (No. 22 of 2023). Pairs with the DPDP Rules, 2025 already in the corpus.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011
documents.notes: Body-corporate data-security and sensitive-personal-data obligations under IT Act s.43A.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology (Procedure and Safeguards for Blocking for Access of Information by Public) Rules, 2009
documents.notes: Government process for blocking unlawful online content under IT Act s.69A; relevant to takedown of NCII and unlawful material.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology (Procedure and Safeguards for Interception, Monitoring and Decryption of Information) Rules, 2009
documents.notes: Lawful interception, monitoring and decryption safeguards under IT Act s.69; supporting context.

documents.document_title: CERT-In Directions under sub-section (6) of section 70B of the Information Technology Act, 2000, dated 28 April 2022
documents.notes: Mandatory cyber-incident reporting (six-hour window) and log-retention directions issued by CERT-In.

documents.document_title: Reserve Bank of India - Customer Protection - Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18, 6 July 2017)
documents.notes: Zero and limited customer liability plus reporting and credit-back timelines for unauthorised electronic banking and online payment fraud.

documents.document_title: The Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2023
documents.notes: Amends the 2021 Intermediary Rules (online gaming intermediaries, fact-check unit, due-diligence changes). The 2022 amendment is not yet in the corpus.

documents.document_title: National Payments Corporation of India - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Procedural Guidelines
documents.notes: UPI dispute-redressal and chargeback mechanics. Mirror copy; verify version and date before production use.

documents.document_title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal - Citizen User Manual (reporting cyber crimes other than child sexual abuse material)
documents.short_title: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal Citizen Manual
documents.notes: MHA / I4C portal manual covering financial fraud, SIM-swap, e-wallet, ransomware reporting and the 1930 helpline. Supplements the 2019 women and children manual.

documents.document_title: Sanchar Saathi / CEIR - Citizen User Manual (blocking a lost or stolen mobile, SIM verification, fraud reporting)
documents.notes: Department of Telecommunications portal guide: block a lost or stolen phone (CEIR), check SIMs registered in your name (TAFCOP), report fraud communications (Chakshu).

documents.document_title: The Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958
documents.notes: Core Delhi rent-control statute.

documents.document_title: The Delhi Rent Control Rules, 1959
documents.notes: Rules under the Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958.

documents.document_title: The Delhi Rent Act, 1995
documents.notes: Manual verification required for current legal status, enforceability, and source authenticity before production use.

documents.document_title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
documents.notes: Supporting property law relevant to leases and transfers.

documents.document_title: The Registration Act, 1908
documents.notes: Supporting document-registration law relevant to lease and property documents.

documents.document_title: The Constitution of India
documents.notes: Core constitutional source.

documents.document_title: The Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
documents.notes: Public-authority and human-rights institutional statute.

documents.document_title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
documents.notes: Core statute for legal aid services.

documents.document_title: The Right to Information Act, 2005
documents.notes: Primary public-authority transparency statute; references to DPDP amendments do not make this the DPDP Act.

documents.document_title: The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971
documents.notes: Specialized court-authority statute.

pending_case_law_note: Case-law PDFs are staged under backend/documents/cyber/case_law/ and are NOT part of the active retrieval index. They are excluded from ingest.py because judgments need a dedicated judgment parser (headnote / holding / ratio) and good-law metadata. Move them into 'documents' only after that parser exists.

pending_case_law.case_name: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
pending_case_law.notes: Struck down IT Act s.66A; upheld s.69A with safeguards; read down s.79(3)(b) intermediary safe harbour. The assistant must never cite s.66A as valid law.

pending_case_law.case_name: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd) v. Union of India
pending_case_law.notes: Right to privacy is a fundamental right under Article 21; basis for personal-data-misuse claims.

pending_case_law.case_name: Anuradha Bhasin v. Union of India
pending_case_law.notes: Internet access is protected under Article 19(1)(a); restrictions and shutdowns must be necessary, proportionate, published and reviewable.

pending_case_law.case_name: Mrs X v. Union of India
pending_case_law.notes: Non-consensual intimate images: intermediaries must proactively remove all instances, not only user-supplied URLs; directions to MeitY and Delhi Police; cybercrime-portal status tracker.

pending_case_law.case_name: Subhranshu Rout @ Gugul v. State of Odisha
pending_case_law.notes: Right to be forgotten within Article 21; a victim's right to have objectionable images removed from social media. Bail order with extended discussion.

pending_case_law.case_name: Sharat Babu Digumarti v. Government (NCT of Delhi)
pending_case_law.notes: The IT Act is a special law and displaces general IPC/BNS provisions for obscene content in electronic form (s.67 / s.79 context).
